Hi, I'm Antony. This is where I write up mathematics I find beautiful: proofs I keep coming back to, problems I'm stuck on, and the occasional picture that explains more than a page of algebra.

<!-- Replace the paragraphs below with your own story. -->

## Interests

Number theory, analysis, and the places where they meet. I like arguments that are short once you see them and pictures that make a theorem feel inevitable.

## About this site

Posts are written in [Quarto](https://quarto.org) markdown with $\LaTeX$ math, rendered with KaTeX, and hosted on GitHub Pages. Each post can be cited (there's a BibTeX entry at the bottom) and every equation can be copied as TeX by hovering it.
